Grandma’s Tomato Soup

A warming soup for cold days.

Ingredients

  • 1 kg tomatoes
  • 1 onion
  • 5 dl vegetable stock

Method

  1. Chop the onion and fry until soft.
  2. Add tomatoes and stock; simmer for 30 minutes.
  3. Blend until smooth.
